sections.h2: Selling an Oak Creek house quickly
sections.html:
Two routes move fastest here: a cash sale to a buyer who takes the house as-is, or a listing priced and prepared to sell within weeks. Oak Creek is a lakeshore suburb just south of Milwaukee, and its mix of owners and renters brings in buyers ranging from families to investors. Either way, the transfer fee, the condition report and the deed filing still apply.

Before you call anyone, put these items on the table so offers and contracts are simple to compare.

  • Your latest tax bill, which carries the ten-digit parcel number
  • A payoff figure from your lender
  • Permit paperwork for any work since you bought the house
  • A written list of what stays and what goes with the house
  • A first draft of your Real Estate Condition Report answers

Then ask every buyer or agent for the closing date, the fees deducted from your proceeds and what happens if an inspection turns up a problem.

Oak Creek has 38,296 residents, up 4.9 percent from the 2020 base. Owners occupy 57.5 percent of the 15,728 households, so rentals are a real part of the market. The median owner-occupied value is $331,700, median monthly owner costs are $1,922 with a mortgage and $838 without one, median gross rent is $1,452 and median household income is $96,555.

New construction gives buyers something to compare your house against. Drexel Town Square, an 85-acre site on part of the old AC Spark Plug grounds, mixes shops, restaurants, housing, a hotel and the civic center. A Millwood Glen housing development by Veridian Homes is also under way. Price your house with newer options in mind.

The Oak Creek-Franklin Joint School District serves all of the city and a seven-square-mile part of Franklin. Its seven elementary schools are Carollton, Cedar Hills, Deerfield, Edgewood, Forest Ridge, Meadowview and Shepard Hills.

Inspection Services handles permits for new construction and alterations, plus plumbing, electrical and heating and air conditioning installs. To book an inspection, call 414-766-7002 with your permit number and a contact name. Inspections are scheduled in a morning block (9 a.m. to noon) or an afternoon block (noon to 3 p.m.), and the city does not honor same-day requests. Status updates appear on BS&A Online when you search by address.

If an earlier owner skipped a permit, a buyer's inspector may flag it. Call Inspection Services at 414-766-7002 to learn what the file shows, then decide whether to close out the permit or disclose the gap.

The city offers four ways to pay: online through the Milwaukee County portal with the ten-digit parcel number from your bill, by mail, in person at City Hall, or at partner bank branches through January 31. The online processor charges 2.55 percent for cards with a $2 minimum, or $1.50 for an e-check. From February 1 through July 31, mailed payments go to the Treasurer, City of Oak Creek, 8040 S 6th Street.

In-person hours at City Hall are 8 am to 4 pm, Monday through Friday, with limited check-only service in December and January. Ask your closing agent how the current bill will be prorated, and ask the treasurer's office for a statement of what is owed on your parcel, special charges included, so the figure at closing matches the city's records.

sections.h2: What you must tell a buyer
sections.html:
If the home has one to four units, you give the buyer a completed Real Estate Condition Report within 10 days after the contract is accepted. A buyer who misses that deadline may rescind within two business days after it, and deposits come back (Wis. Stat. 709.02). Wis. Stat. 709.01 excuses court-appointed fiduciaries who never lived in the property and transfers that are exempt from the fee.

Foreclosure transfers are a good example. A foreclosure or deed in lieu to a mortgage holder is one of the exempt transfers in Wis. Stat. 77.25(14). An owner selling voluntarily before foreclosure still has to complete the report.

The state transfer fee is 30 cents per $100 of value under Wis. Stat. 77.22, charged to the seller and collected by the register of deeds. Add the $30 recording charge. Here is how the Milwaukee County Register of Deeds, 901 N. 9th Street, Room 103, handles a deed.

Milwaukee County recording at a glance
ItemWhat to expect
Recording fee$30 per document
PaymentCash, check or money order, no cards
Transfer returnElectronic receipt required for every conveyance
Recording timeThree to five business days, in the order received
Return by mailOne to two weeks
Contact414-278-4005 or RODrecordings@milwaukeecountywi.gov

Selling is often possible, but the paperwork depends on how title was held. When a spouse has died, the county uses the Termination of Decedent's Interest form (HT-110) with a $30 fee and an exemption under Wis. Stat. 77.25(11). A personal representative selling an estate home should confirm authority with the probate court or an attorney first, since a buyer's title company will ask who is allowed to sign.

faqs.q: Does Milwaukee County accept a card for recording a deed?
faqs.a: No. The office takes cash, checks or money orders payable to the Register of Deeds. The $30 recording fee applies per document, and any transfer fee shown on your electronic return receipt is paid at the same time.

faqs.q: Can I sell an Oak Creek house if the owner has died?
faqs.a: Often yes, but the paperwork depends on how title was held. After a spouse's death the county uses form HT-110 with a $30 fee. A personal representative should confirm authority with the probate court or an attorney first.

faqs.q: How long does it take to schedule a building inspection in Oak Creek?
faqs.a: Call 414-766-7002 with your permit number. The city does not do same-day inspections, and requests are filled in order in morning or afternoon blocks, so book early.

faqs.q: Do I need a condition report for a foreclosure sale?
faqs.a: A transfer exempt from the transfer fee is also excused from the report under Wis. Stat. 709.01, and a foreclosure or deed in lieu to a mortgage holder is one of them. An owner selling voluntarily before foreclosure must still provide it.

faqs.q: Which office tells me what I owe in property tax?
faqs.a: The City Treasurer at City Hall handles payments and can confirm balances for your parcel. In-person hours are 8 am to 4 pm, Monday through Friday, with limited check-only service in December and January.
